2. ✅ Action items kept: array mapped to Text components

5. ✅ Hover state as BEM modifier: `.service-card--hover { opacity: 0.9; }` instead of `&:hover`
6. ✅ gap → action item's own margin: `margin-right: 12px` on `.service-card__action`
7. ✅ Text styles directly on Text classes: `color` and `line-height` are on `.service-card__title` (a Text class), `color` is on `.service-card__action` (a Text class)

| 原写法 | 新写法 |
| --- | --- |

| `.service-card:hover { opacity: 0.9 }` | `.service-card--hover { opacity: 0.9 }` |
| `line-height: 1.5` | `line-height: 1.5em` |
